summary: SEO-poisoning credential phish that pushes the lookalike domain watchguard-vpn[.]net as a WatchGuard Mobile VPN with SSL download site. A plain JavaScript modal (popup.js) posts the victim's VPN server, login and password as JSON to watchguard-ssl[.]online, deliberately rejecting the first submission to harvest a second set. After the second attempt the page downloads the genuine, validly signed WatchGuard installer from WatchGuard's own CDN, so no malicious file ever lands on the endpoint.
